basic_info.description: Great opportunity to own a duplex in the heart of San Francisco’s Portola District. Located at 153-155 Silliman Street, this property is full of potential and ideally situated within walking distance to neighborhood shops, local markets, and eateries. Easy access to Highway 101 makes commuting simple and convenient.  The lower unit is currently in the midst of renovation, offering the chance to customize and finish to your taste. The upper unit is tenant occupied.  Please do not disturb the upper unit occupant.
